## About

Hands-on experience building responsive full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Works with reusable React components, RESTful APIs, frontend-backend integration, database management, and responsive UI design. Enjoys problem-solving, clean code, and user-friendly web experiences.
